title: Text Monkey: a clearer week
format: Silent actual-UI walkthrough with burned-in English captions
simulation_badge: FICTIONAL PREVIEW | NO LIVE AI OR DELIVERY

shots.title: Ordinary texts. A clearer week.
shots.caption: Text Monkey brings volunteer scheduling and coordinator decisions together. This walkthrough uses fictional data in the disconnected public preview.

shots.title: See what needs you
shots.caption: Open the demo. Home shows open spots, decisions waiting, and upcoming event coverage. The coordinator can see where attention is needed.

shots.title: Keep the important facts visible
shots.caption: Open Volunteers. Availability, recorded consent, and clearance are shown together. These sample records do not establish consent for real people.

shots.title: Review a fictional profile
shots.caption: Open a sample profile, then cancel without saving. A phone number does not grant an administrator login.

shots.title: Find the staffing gap
shots.caption: Open Shifts. Six of eight roles are covered, with two open spots. The preview keeps its scheduling and delivery limits visible.

shots.title: Try the manual sample controls
shots.caption: The preview has manual booking controls. Only the selected slot is affected. Automatic replacement search, live AI, and texts do not run here.

shots.title: The selected slot reopens
shots.caption: Cancel the fictional nursery booking. Coverage changes from two people to one. The visible notice confirms that no replacement was assigned.

shots.title: Make the decision understandable
shots.caption: Open Messages. A fictional cancellation and exact sample response are visible for review. Approval is disabled here. Connected interpretation and composition use Gloo.

shots.title: Know whether the connection is ready
shots.caption: Open Settings. Connected admins save their mobile number for updates. This preview cannot save a real recipient or deliver a message.

shots.title: Clear limits. Useful next steps.
shots.caption: Preview only. Replacement ranking is unfinished; live integration writes stay held.
